High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Sandeep And 3 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Arvind Kumar Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.
Sri Anil Kumar Bind, Advocate, has entered appearance and filed his Vakalatnama on behalf of the informant- opposite party no. 2.
The same is taken on record.

2. This application has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 63 of 2022, under Sections 406, 420, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Malawan, District Etah.

3. At the outset learned AGA has raised a preliminary objection that against the cognizance and summoning order dated 22.09.2022, the applicants had earlier approached this Court by filing Application U/s 482 No. 35576 of 2022 (Sandeep Kumar and 3 others v. State of U.P. and another).

entities.text: Sandeep Kumar and 3 others v. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The said application was disposed of by this Court vide order dated 03.11.2022 on the basis of Sandeep And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139051081/
1 statement of the counsel for the applicants that the applicants are ready to surrender before the court concerned and seek their bail.

entities.text: Sandeep And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Pursuant to the said order the applicants had not appeared before the trial court.
He further submits that the applicants are absconding and are evading the process of law.
Bailable and non-bailable warrants have been issued against the applicants on 16.02.2023 and 15.07.2024 respectively.
On that ground, he submits that the applicants are not entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Neeraj Kumar Sharma, learned A.G.A. for the State- opposite party no.1, and Sri Anil Kumar Bind, learned counsel for the informant- opposite party no.
2, and perused the record.
5.
The order-sheet of the trial court records that after submission of the charge-sheet, summon was issued to the applicants on 22.09.2022.
The applicants failed to appear.
Consequently, bailable and non-bailable warrants have been issued on 16.02.2023 and 15.07.2024 respectively.
The applicants are well aware of the pending proceedings.
The issuance of coercive measures against the applicants by the trial court has also not been disputed by the counsel for the applicants.
6. In view, thereof, such conduct of the applicants does not entitle them for grant of anticipatory bail.
7. Accordingly, the application is hereby rejected.

Order Date :- 14.8.2024 SKT/-
